name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
how_to:
1. Set Up the Cable Machine
  - Attach a straight bar, EZ curl bar, or rope to the high pulley of a cable machine.
  - Select an appropriate weight that allows controlled movement without compromising form.
2. Position Yourself
  - Kneel on the floor in front of the cable machine, bending your body so that your elbows are fixed to the bench.
  - Grip the attachment with an overhand grip (palms facing down) and bring it close to your forehead.
  - Keep your elbows tucked in and aligned with your shoulders.
3. Execution
  - Engage your core and stabilize your upper body.
  - Extend your elbows forward by pushing the handle or rope attachment away from your forehead until your arms are fully extended.
  - Keep your upper arms stationary while moving only your forearms.
  - Squeeze your triceps at the end of the movement.
  - Slowly return to the starting position by bending your elbows while maintaining control.
4. Repeat
  - Perform the desired number of repetitions while maintaining proper form.
